# AIFA — AI Atomic Feature Architecture

> AIFA is an AI-native software architecture for full-stack applications built from explicit, independently testable feature contracts. Human developers and AI coding agents work against the same declared boundaries.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/AdrianBesleaga/AIFA
Project website: https://adrianbesleaga.github.io/AIFA/

- [Feature ticket contract](./docs/ticket-contract.md): Reusable contract for specifying an atomic feature.

## Core concepts

- Each product use case is a feature slice under `contexts/<bounded-context>/features/<feature>/`.
- `feature.definition.json` declares business need, contracts, route, security, capabilities, MCP exposure, UI slots, and acceptance work.
- `manifest.ts` binds the declaration to executable backend, frontend, and MCP composition.
- Features receive runtime-granted capabilities and do not import databases, HTTP frameworks, environment configuration, or provider SDKs.
- HTTP and MCP adapters invoke the same feature implementation.
- React features compose through named, typed UI slots.
- JSON Schema, generated types, import rules, runtime checks, and behavioral tests enforce boundaries.

## Relationship to established architectures

- AIFA is closest to Vertical Slice Architecture, adding machine-readable contracts, runtime capability grants, full-stack composition, and explicit agent guidance.
- AIFA can organize atomic features inside a modular monolith or an individual microservice.
- Clean Architecture and Hexagonal Architecture can still define dependency direction around AIFA capabilities and infrastructure adapters.
- Frontend Feature-Sliced Design overlaps with AIFA's locality goals, while AIFA extends the boundary across backend execution, security, transports, and events.
- AIFA is most useful for parallel human/AI delivery, multiple entry points such as HTTP and MCP, enforceable security boundaries, and replaceable infrastructure.

## Instructions for AI coding agents

- Read the nearest `AGENTS.md` before editing.
- Treat `demo/ai-todo-assistant/ARCHITECTURE.md` as authoritative for implementation decisions.
- Keep feature behavior local and core infrastructure generic.
- Run `npm run check`, `npm test`, and `npm run build` from `demo/ai-todo-assistant/` after code changes.
